name: Tuna nicoise salad
steps: Boil the new potatoes until tender, then halve.
Cook the green beans until just crisp, then drain.
Boil the egg, cool, peel and quarter it.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans and tomatoes on a plate.
Flake the tuna over the top and add the olives.
Drizzle with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.
